_comment: Committed host paths for CSD3 ampere (A100-80GB SXM4, sm80) under Slurm. Values are FILESYSTEM LOCATIONS, never design (D-609). Boot fails closed if flexidepth_weights, conditional_graph_helper or moe_config_dir is absent. Unlike the Vast container, /rds is the real shared filesystem here, so these paths are stable across allocations and every node sees the same bytes.
